adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that in packages/app-store/webex/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts, the code uses refreshOAuthTokens() but then parses the response with webexRefreshedTokenSchema.safeParse(responseBody) at line 90 (visible in diff). Unlike other integrations (zoom, office365, google) that were updated to use parseRefreshTokenResponse(), Webex was not updated. The parseRefreshTokenResponse function handles the case when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true by using a minimal schema. Since Webex still uses the strict webexRefreshedTokenSchema directly, when credential sync is enabled and returns only access_token and expiry, the schema validation will fail because it requires additional fields like scope, token_type, refresh_token, and refresh_token_expires_in.
